name: Cookie Clicker Access
description: Screen-reader and keyboard access for Cookie Clicker, published on Steam Workshop as Screen Reader Accessibility Enhancements. This fork adds Steam-only support for Frozen Cookies and Grandpa's Greenhouse. The GitHub ZIP and web userscript are separate distributions.

blockers: The catalogue snapshot is unsigned; native catalogue consumption and trusted external-action dispatch are not implemented.
Workshop local-installation observation is not implemented. Subscription, in-game activation and Workshop payload version have not been observed.

recommendations.reason: Optional automation and statistics, with Steam-only menu and text-readout support in Cookie Clicker Access. Its automation settings remain separate.
Optional Garden automation with Steam-only accessibility support. Frozen Cookies' optional 100% Consistency Combo can overwrite Garden plans.
